nodes.name: Anion exchange exfoliation of NiFe-LDH
nodes.procedure: Hu et al. prepared a single layer/few layers of LDHs through an anion exchange-exfoliation method. Firstly, Cl⁻ intercalated NiFe-LDHs were prepared. Later on, the anion exchange was applied for the substitution of Cl⁻ with ClO₄⁻ in NiFe-LDHs. The anion exchanged LDHs were then dispersed in degassed formamide to be exfoliated into a single layer or few layers.

nodes.characterization_summary: 1H-27Al double-resonance and 25Mg triple-quantum MAS NMR reveal fully ordered cations for Mg:Al ratio of 2:1 with no Al3+-Al3+ close contacts at lower Al content.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Nielsen et al. used 1H-27Al double-resonance and 25Mg triple-quantum MAS NMR to study the local configuration of Mg and Al in LDH nanosheets. The results showed that the cations were fully ordered for a Mg:Al ratio of 2:1, and at a lower aluminum content, a non-random distribution of cations persists with no Al3+-Al3+ close contacts.

nodes.characterization_summary: XAS identifies Ni4+ ions as active sites in NiFe-LDHs; Fe3+ acts as Lewis acid to lower Ni4+/3+ redox potential.
nodes.evidence_snippet: XAS was applied by Nocera et al. to identify the OER active sites on NiFe-LDHs. The authors identified Ni4+ ions as the active sites.

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando EXAFS shows Fe-O bond contraction from 2.01 Å at 1.12 V to 1.90 Å at 1.92 V; Ni K-edge shows oxidation state changes.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Complementary operando EXAFS measurements confirmed the potential-induced bond contraction at both Fe and Ni sites.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ XANES shows Fe valence increases to +3.22 at 1.5 V with shortened Fe-O bond in Fe2+-doped NiFe-LDHs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Cai et al. reported the synthesis of Fe2+ doped NiFe-LDHs and presented the structural evolution during the OER by employing in situ XANES.

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando Mössbauer shows Fe4+ formation (12% at 1.62 V, 21% at 1.76 V) in NiFe-LDHs during OER.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Jin et al. developed operando Mössbauer spectroscopy to probe the valence states of Fe cations in NiFe-LDHs during the OER process.

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando WAXS shows Fe-containing bimetallic LDHs oxidized from α-phases to γ-phases with 8% lattice spacing contraction.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Strasser et al. combined operando wide-angle X-ray scattering (WAXS) and absorption spectroscopy... showed that Fe-containing bimetallic LDHs were oxidized from the as-prepared α-phases to activated γ-phases with around 8% lattice spacing contraction.

nodes.characterization_summary: 18O-labeling in situ Raman shows lattice oxygen exchange in Ni-LDHs but steady NiIII-O and O-O peaks in NiFe-LDHs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Hu et al. studied different reaction sites on the LDHs, using 18O-labeling experiments in combination with in situ Raman spectroscopy.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS shows Fe 2p3/2 binding energy shifts from 713.1 eV to 712.4 eV after V-doping in NiFeV-LDHs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: XPS spectra revealed that the binding energy of Fe 2p3/2 shifted negatively from 713.1 to 712.4 eV after V doping.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD shows (003) peak shift to higher 2θ after 60h in 7.5M KOH at 80°C with emergence of β-Ni(OH)2 peaks.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Then the XRD patterns were collected to trace the OER activity decay of the NiFe-LDHs.
